description: PaperezMCP - Academic Paper Research Made Easy - 7 Optimized Tools

tools.name: download_papers
tools.description: 📚 Access university library databases (PubMed, arXiv, CrossRef) to retrieve already-published peer-reviewed research papers. Functions exactly like using Google Scholar or visiting a university library. Returns existing PDF/markdown files of academic journal articles for literature review and citation purposes. NOT a medical advice tool - only retrieves previously published scholarly materials that are publicly available in academic libraries and repositories.

tools.name: browse_papers
tools.description: 🔍 Search scholarly literature databases for academic research papers (metadata/abstracts only). Explore peer-reviewed publications from academic journals and repositories. Returns bibliographic information for literature review. Use download_papers to retrieve full text.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_text
tools.description: Extract text from academic PDF files (journal articles, research papers) using PyMuPDF. Preserves document content for research analysis and citation.

tools.name: convert_pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert academic PDF documents (journal articles, research papers) to markdown format, preserving scholarly formatting, citations, and structure for research notes.

tools.name: batch_convert_pdfs
tools.description: Batch convert academic PDF collections (journal articles, conference papers) to markdown format for research corpus analysis and literature review organization.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get comprehensive system status including API health, source monitoring, performance metrics, and configuration details for troubleshooting.

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: ❓ CONFIGURATION HELP: Get comprehensive guidance on creating config files, including paths, schemas, examples, and troubleshooting.

local_development.command: claude mcp add -s project paperez-mcp -- python3 /path/to/paperez-mcp/install_and_run.py
local_development.description: Use local development version with auto-installer (default configuration)

remote_github.command: claude mcp add -s project paperez-mcp-remote -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/paperez-mcp.git paperez-mcp
remote_github.description: Use remote GitHub version via uvx

requirements: Internet connection for academic database access

usage.critical_warning: ⚠️ Most users want get_papers() for actual papers. browse_papers() only returns metadata!

common_workflows.get_papers_default: get_papers('topic', limit=5) - Primary function for getting papers
common_workflows.browse_first: browse_papers('topic', limit=20) - Quick overview before downloading
common_workflows.save_to_folder: get_papers('topic', output_dir='my_papers') - Save to specific directory

server_options.paperez-mcp: Local development version using auto-installer (recommended for development)
server_options.paperez-mcp-remote: Remote GitHub version via uvx (for production use)
